verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's RTX 5090 page documents a hardware media engine, the "ninth-gen NVIDIA Encoder", alongside NVIDIA Broadcast, and points creators to "NVIDIA Studio creator tools and technology." Neither item names codecs or app acceleration specifics, so the story is only thinly covered. Missing for 10: explicit AV1/HEVC encode/decode codec documentation, encoder/decoder count or specs, documentation of Studio/ISV-certified driver support, named creator-app acceleration (e.g., editing/3D apps), and independent hands-on corroboration of media-engine performance.

support.subject: As a creator, hardware media engines and creator-app acceleration are documented — AV1/HEVC encoders, and professional or ISV-certified driver support where the vendor claims it
